title: Technician - L. Save as canned line (carrying attached inspection template)
preconds: Logged in as Technician. Tech View. Per SV-8095 AC4, View Mode is NOT a gate for inspections. A work order line has an attached (published) inspection template.
steps:
1. Log in.
  2. Open a work order line that has an attached inspection template.
  3. From the line's three-dot menu, choose "Save as canned line".
expected: Step 3: Allowed. "Save as canned line" - including carrying the line's attached inspection template - requires WOL Create and Edit, NOT Settings > Service (the template is only referenced, already published). Technician has WOL Create and Edit. (SV-8095 AC7; fixes SV-7872.)
